items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-09-01
items.q: And a fella named Robert Henry had the outfit. And he asked each man in the band... I said okay. I didn't care if I make a thing or not... And I got five hundred and something out of it.

ctx.x: I got to go take a little beach.

So if he ain't got it now he'll never get it. That's for sure. And never forget I went to Memphis on an excursion from Chicago with a band. I had the band and they had five pieces. And a fella named Robert Henry had the outfit. And he asked each man in the band. He said uh now we're going in Memphis to a dance hall. And he said uh I think we're going to do good. He said now would y'all like to go in with the dance or just want a salary? And every one of them wanted a salary. They wanted twelve dollars a man for…
Well, how far away did you say they could hear you when you played trumpet and race last?
